protocol.dev: dev10k rows 0:512; no test-set scoring or tuning
protocol.probe: every update through 64; eight points per doubling thereafter; final update
protocol.dense: 12 runs: four non-full-BPTT methods, seeds 0-2; use matched final-run fit clock
protocol.deferred: 88 runs: remaining seeds plus full BPTT all20; use own fit clock
protocol.bptt: 60,000-update cosine at lr60, knob10, l1 0.1; distinct from Table7 lr2 long runs
protocol.time_axis: raw fit_s retained; startup = fit[1] - median(diff(fit[1:22])); paper adds ready_s from final seeds0-2
protocol.reuse: Reuse final-run clocks for dense seeds0-2. Sparse Table7 checkpoints cannot supply missing dense probes.
protocol.timing: Blackwell hardware; retain per-host/GPU curves and never claim H200 timing equivalence
